svg.title: Event-Driven Agent Trigger Patterns
svg.desc: Four event sources trigger an AI agent in AI Foundry, each through an integration service: an email arriving in Exchange via Logic Apps, a form submitted in Power Apps via Power Automate, a queue message in Service Bus via an Azure Function, and a document uploaded to Blob Storage via Event Grid. The agent then takes actions: update CRM, send response, or create ticket.
svg.text: Event sources reach the agent through an integration service; the agent then acts.
